Chapter 6906: No Dao

Chapter 6906: No Dao

“My turn!” Apex Heavenly Devil leaped into the fray, turning into a gigantic eye to illuminate Li Qiye.

It locked everything in place before the devour. However, this was utterly useless.

Li Qiye’s smirk humiliated him, not bothering to even react to the move.

“You are mighty, Fellow Daoist.” The gorgeous Godfiend spoke charmingly, capable of mesmerizing overlords.

She could satisfy all fantasies and desires, whether it be an incomparably enchanting beauty who let one indulge to their heart’s content, or an unattainable fairy to fulfill one’s need for conquest, or perhaps a dao companion to share an eternal love...

With just one sentence, she could make cultivators fall into hidden sexual desires. When she activated her domain of desire, the immortals immediately protected their minds.

She was born from death and relied on death to become an immortal. As one indulged in her domain, they would be wrapped by death as well until their essences became hers.

She approached, placing her hands on his shoulders. Her domain erupted, forcing her allies back. She turned into numerous forms to enchant him.

“You’re hideous.” He smiled.

His words struck her like a lightning spear, sending her flying.

“Bastard!” This offended her heart devil as he proved it with her domain’s failure.

“No way you are impervious!” Big-foot activated his special boots, exerting both speed and power.

As they reached their highest speed, thirty-three layers of firmament stacked beneath them.

“Firmament Stomp!” He shouted before stomping on Li Qiye.

However, he couldn’t even make Li Qiye’s robe move an inch - a futile contest between cotton and metal.

He retreated with haste, astounded just like the other immortals. They tried their best move but couldn’t injure him at all. Guangmai also stood up and stared in amazement.

“My turn.” Fire Immortal moved forward: “What is your dao?”

“No dao.” Li Qiye stood casually without any defensive stance.

They exchanged glances of doubt. Even celestial immortals had dao; all cultivators did.

“Very well, the wrath of the high heaven will descend upon you.” Fire Immortal roared.

The crowd backed off again since all feared the high heaven, whether it be its flames or lightning bolts.
